Module net.automatalib.util

Package net.automatalib.util.partitionrefinement

package net.automatalib.util.partitionrefinement
  • Class
    Description
    AutomatonInitialPartitioning
    This enum allows to conveniently specify how the states of a deterministic automaton are initially partitioned when initializing the partition refinement data structure.
    Block
    A block (i.e., partition class) that is maintained during the Paige/Tarjan partition refinement algorithm (see Hopcroft).
    Hopcroft
    An implementation of Hopcroft's algorithm for computing the functional coarsest partition.
    HopcroftExtractors
    This class provides methods for translating the result of a Hopcroft coarsest stable partition computation into several common, more usable forms such as automata.
    HopcroftInitializers
    This class provides several methods to initialize a Hopcroft partition refinement data structure from common sources, e.g., automata.
    PruningMode
    Allows for controlling how automata are pruned during minimization.
    StateSignature
    Utility class for constructing state signatures used for classifying states during minimization / bisimulation,.
    Valmari
    Valmari's algorithm for computing the relational coarsest partition as presented in Simple Bisimilarity Minimization in O(m log n) Time by Antti Valmari.
    Valmari.RefinablePartition
    A refinable partition data structure.
    ValmariExtractors
    Utility methods for extracting various automaton types from Valmari objects.
    ValmariInitializers
    Utility methods for initializing Valmari objects from various automaton types.
